name: Des Sheridan
description: In Des' own words, he's a "grumpy old man with no qualifications and a guitar". In my words, Des creates music that shows a lived life, full of experiences both joyful and dreary. He doesn’t soften the truth, his songs don’t try to sound profound — they are profound because they’re plainspoken. His music is spare. Yet, when Des plays, it pulls you in.

name: Nalu
description: Hailing from Torquay, Victoria, Nalu’s never forced himself to play, he picks up the handpan whenever he’s driven to it. His music always flows from a natural source of inspiration. According to Nalu, he plays “what sounds good in my head and what I feel. It’s an expression of myself”. Put this one on the TV while cooking or before bed for a deep relaxation.

name: Trey AKA Some Respect for our Elders
description: Trey is an Indigenous Australian rapper and didgeridoo player who lives with Downs Syndrome. Trey's rapping is straight off the dome, a flow of consciousness, if you will. Meeting Trey was an absolute pleasure, his cheeky personality and love for his family flows through his playing and his music. Special thanks to Mosaic Elite Health for making this video possible.

name: Grub
description: Grub is a singer-songwriter from Fulham, Victoria. With his unique, gritty voice, Grub's songwriting shines through his performances, which range from brooding, thoughtful verses to dynamic, punchy choruses. Grub's immense talent is a must listen for fans of blues, folk and country,

name: Jess Joy
description: Jess Joy is a blues-folk artist originally from Ohio, now living in the south coast of NSW. Her distinctive, raspy vocal style and deeply personal songwriting make her music instantly captivating and memorable.

name: The Cicada Club
description: The Cicada Club is a four piece Jug band from Central West NSW playing covers and originals in the style of ragtime, swing and hokum blues.

name: Hope Held Hostage
description: Hope Held Hostage is an Alt-Rock band from Dubbo formed in June 2023 by vocalist Sebastian Berry. Taking influences from grunge gods like Silverchair, Alice in Chains, and Audioslave - these hard hitting rockers aren't a band to miss.

name: Brother Hollow
description: Brother Hollow are a Tamworth-based country duo delivering raw Australian storytelling with a modern country punch. Built on real-life experience, dusty backroads, and unshakable mateship, their music captures the grit and heart of regional Australia.

name: Joe Newton
description: Born and raised on Gumbaynggirr Country in the mountains of Dorrigo, Joe Newton writes songs grounded in place, memory, and human experience. His work explores love, loss, belonging, change, and our relationship to land and community. Delivered through blues, folk, soul and story-driven songwriting, they are songs that come out of the dirt and the rain.

name: Hawk Kestrel
description: From a secret location in the Coffs Coast area, Hawk Kestrel are a one-of-a-kind, must see duo. Defined by Pennie Lennon’s cinematic piano playing and Wild Man Brun’s psych rock inspired guitar, Hawk Kestrel bring a performance straight from 1969 to your ears.

name: Franky Busta
description: Franky Busta’s a musician who’s been playing in pubs for the past 2 years. In that time, he’s written many originals he wants to share. Franky’s writing pulls from all aspects of both his own life and other people’s - through this he writes music that people relate to and hear on a deeper level. He’s been playing guitar for almost 8 years and singing as long as he can remember.

name: Scott Green Band
description: Scott Green Band is a Gladstone based high-energy four-piece that brings the stage to life with big, crowd-pleasing rock anthems inspired by the 2000s era. Their set it tight, loud, and relentlessly fun. Hook driven songs, punchy rhythms and an electric live presence that keeps people singing, jumping and locked in from the first note to the last.

name: Fern
description: Fern are a three-piece psych indie rock band from Yeppoon, blending hazy guitars, driving rhythms, and dreamy melodies into a sound that's equal parts coastal nostalgia and late-night chaos. Drawing from psychedelic rock, modern indie, and reggae, Fern craft immersive sets that shift between atmospheric grooves and raw, energetic hooks.

name: Tropical State of Mind
description: Tropical State of Mind are an Aussie band that blends indie, pop, soul, funk, and rock into a sound that’s raw, vibrant, and full of emotion. Fronted by powerhouse vocalist and songwriter Jezzie, their music is made for connection, movement, and soul-stirring moments.

name: Marco Polo
description: Starring Marco Polo, world traveler and songwriter. After being born in India and living his childhood near Venice, Italy, he moved to Australia at the age of nine. Marco Polo has travelled the past twenty years exploring places, mindfulness, and music. Formerly known as Satya Matteo.

name: Amber Farnan
description: Amber Farnan makes music for the beautifully overwhelmed, blending the raw closeness of indie-folk confession with modern pop production.

name: Adam Harpaz
description: Adam Harpaz is an born and raised singer-songwriter, residing on Arakwal country in the Northern Rivers of New South Wales. Adam's music is uniquely relatable; painting pictures of hope for the listener through lyrical integrity, warm productions and heartfelt performances.

name: Leo Hooker
description: Dubbed by his peers as the “King of Outback Lonesome”, Leo Hooker offers shelter within his unique brand of smooth, vintage, heart-driven songwriting; drawn from a well carved by the human experiences of heartache, love and loneliness.

name: Katanga Jr and Aife
description: Born & raised in Tanzania but now calling Mparntwe (Alice Springs) home, Katanga Junior is an exciting, charismatic artist who has captivated audiences across the Territory since arriving 5 years ago. Seamlessly integrating himself into the local music scene, Junior has developed a dedicated fan base thanks to his distinctively deep voice, smooth flow & multilingual lyrics.

name: Reclaimed
description: Reclaimed is a small local Darwin alt-rock band who play high energy, intimate shows. They are a youth band building a growing community around their local music scene.

name: Emma Stocker & The Everstars
description: Eclectic and soulful, Emma Stocker & the Ever Stars play in a converted warehouse, in Darwin's tropical heat. 🌺

name: Stellar Moon
description: Stellar Moon is a proud Nyikina woman from the Kimberley, based in Broome. With bold & powerful presence, Stellar guides us on a journey of liberation and empowerment! Compelling vocals, funky riffs, blues grit and a whole lot of soul. Weaving her mob’s Nyikina language through songs, Stellar promotes deeper connection to self, culture and ‘Country’.

name: Bloodworks
description: Performing since the age of 13, Bloodworks (Declan Pocock) is a WA based solo youth artist who writes heavy metal music.

name: Family Shoveller Band
description: Family Shoveller Band is a family band from the remote community of Bidyadanga, WA. The group originally started off as a busking band and now play music in the mainstream of Aboriginal music including reggae, culture rock, country fusion, pop rock and reggae to people all around Australia.

name: Alexia Parenzee
description: Blown in on a Mid West southerly, The Alexia Parenzee Band is a soulful roots collective hailing from regional Western Australia. Fronted by award-winning singer-songwriter Alexia Parenzee, the five-piece is known for their salt-of-the-earth sound, a blend of blissful acoustic grooves, buttery melodies, and earthy beats.

name: Batavia Butchery
description: Batavia Butchery is a Geraldton-based metal band writing original songs about the "Batavia" vessel, and a mutinity that happened at the Abrolhos islands nearly 400 years ago.

name: The Goddamn Darlings
description: The Goddamn Darlings have been brewing their sweet, shrieking noise rock in the Wadandi/Boorloo area and expelling it sweatily at their live gigs. The Darlings blend punk, noise, and Aussie vitality to create their original sound.

name: Window
description: Window, a real band.

name: Shiver
description: Shiver are a desert rock band from Margaret River. For fans of Queens of the Stone Age.

name: Yaz + The Universe
description: Yaz and the Universe is a three-piece musical project made up of Zephyr, Akku and Nemji, creating experimental, story-driven songs that blur the line between music, character and atmosphere. Pulling from whatever sounds, ideas and strange little narratives happen to find them, the band treats each song like its own world—sometimes chaotic, sometimes dreamy, sometimes a little unsettling, but always unmistakably theirs.
